notes.title: Ver.1.1.0 Update
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing Mamizou's Mimic Check![/p][p][/p][p]--Fixed the button layout on the result screen to prevent accidental operations.[/p][p]--Added a feature to allow quick retry by pressing the [b]R[/b] key after a stage starts.[/p][p]--Added a feature to allow checks using the arrow keys after a stage starts.[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate your continued support![/p]

notes.title: Ver.0.9.21 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Mamizou's Mimic Check!
We’re very happy about it!

We’ve quickly fixed some of the reported issues.

--Fixed a bug where stage records would be erased when retrying from the "Retry" button during the game.

--Adjusted the volume control to allow adjustments in 1% and 10% increments.
--Fixed a bug where the achievement "Stage 4 Clear" could not be obtained.

We appreciate your continued support!
